Papers must contain new fundamental condensed-matter science; routine property calculations without new physics do not meet the stated scope.

venues.name: Journal of Public Policy
venues.scope_notes: Social-science theories and concepts applied to political, economic and social issues and policymaking. Comparative existing-data research and policy analysis can fit. Statistical papers must provide replication materials, subject to justified legal/ethical exceptions.

route.conditions: Current journal policy is wholly Gold OA. The stated APC is GBP 2,610 or USD 3,655, with possible additional taxes. Institutional agreements, Cambridge Open Equity and Research4Life can cover eligible authors. Corresponding authors of research articles without those routes may request a discount/full waiver after acceptance, assessed by Cambridge. This is a conditional research-article route. Submission fees are not expressly addressed in the inspected instructions. Research manuscripts normally have 5,000–8,000 body words and a 45-page maximum.
route.other_mandatory_costs: APC and applicable tax unless covered or waived; submission and any other compulsory charges remain unconfirmed. Language-editing services are expressly voluntary.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific policy establishes wholly OA publication and lists GBP 2,610/USD 3,655 APCs plus possible tax when an APC is required.
Lists conditional funding routes and post-acceptance discount/full-waiver requests. It also states a financial-barrier assurance; Cambridge assesses and provides waivers.
Article-type section treats Research Articles, Reviews and Field Essays as APC-funded research types; Letters require no APC. It specifies length limits and voluntary language services.
Submission instructions inspected; no explicit submission-fee statement located.

ai_policy.summary: Journal instructions contemplate generated manuscript text and research data analysis under disclosure and human accountability; explicit analysis permission covers analytical code in this workflow.

disclosure.instructions: Declare generated text in acknowledgements or footnote, data collection or analysis in Methods, generated visuals in captions; describe tool name/version, use, dates and access as reasonably possible, and third-party citations. The journal additionally requires assistance in drafting manuscripts to be noted in both the cover letter and acknowledgements, with authors declaring full responsibility for scientific content.

restrictions: Authors remain accountable, verify outputs and references, and must not list AI as an author.
